summary: The amendment is the property-shaped, narrowly bounded Limb D the audit asked for: five conditions, per-row independent review, an express bar on labels/difficulty/undecided numbers, re-entry with owners, overturn restoring the unsplit rule. SD-1..SD-5 ride real measured leftoverDesign members and match the security unit's dispositions exactly. Two wording repairs keep it inside D-132 clause 2 / D-133 and make the recording manifest executable for SD-6..SD-8.
